scenarios.prompt: A new product has 1 review out of 1 total purchase, and the review is positive. Compute the Wilson score lower bound at 95% confidence (this is what should be used for ranking, NOT the raw 100%). Report wilson_lower, wilson_center, wilson_upper.
A product received 0 positive reviews out of 100 total. Compute the Wilson score 95% confidence interval. Report wilson_lower, wilson_center, wilson_upper.
A product has 47 positive reviews out of 53 total. Compute the Wilson score interval at 99% confidence (NOT the more common 95%). Report wilson_lower, wilson_center, wilson_upper.
A product has 8 positive reviews out of 10 total purchases. Compute the Wilson score 95% confidence interval. Report wilson_lower, wilson_center, wilson_upper.
